_comment: Gate raids (Scripts/gate_raid_manager.gd). Every so often, while a player is near the town gate, a small band of bandits or goblins spawns out on the road and marches on the gate. Guards banter, go out to meet them, and wear them down; they leave the killing to the players (soften_seconds, then they finish the job). Host/single-player: /raid [bandits|goblins] starts one now.

Times are real-world minutes. 'spawn' is where the band appears (snapped to the navmesh), 'approach_distance' is how far outside the gate marker they march to, count is [min, max] before the extra raiders per additional player nearby (extra_per_players, capped at max_raiders).
All the lines are DRAFTS awaiting the user's approval. Guards named in the 'guards' lists must be the guard's npc_name; if that guard is not around, any guard near the gate says it.

bandits.announce: Bandits are attacking the town gate!
shouts: Open the gates, or we'll open them ourselves!
Lumoran coin, Lumoran wine, and nobody to stop us. Take it all!
Nobody's coming to save you, Wardens!

goblins.announce: Goblins are attacking the town gate!
shouts: Shinies! Shinies in the big walls!
Grukka wants the gate! Grukka gets the gate!
Little metal men, we eat you!

bandits.line: Riders on the south road! Bandits! Wardens, to the gate!
Steady. Let them come to us. Anyone with a blade, stand with the Wardens!

goblins.line: Goblins! A whole warband from the southeast! Wardens, to the gate!
Hold the line. They don't fight fair, so don't you dare drop your guard. Anyone with a blade, stand with us!

arrive.line: You'll find the gate stays shut. Try it.

cleared.line: That's the last of them. Well fought, all of you.
Back to your posts. And thank the ones who stood with us.

fizzled.line: They've broken off. Stay sharp; they'll be back.
